quote: A signal of intention to turn right or left, or otherwise turn a vehicle from a direct course, shall be given continuously during not less than the last 100 feet traveled in a business or residential district and not less than the last 300 feet traveled in any other area prior to changing the course of a vehicle. This rule shall be observed, regardless of the weather.

activation.source_clause: A signal of intention to turn right or left, or otherwise turn a vehicle from a direct course
activation.description: Original change of course and signal visibility need review.

obligation.source_clause: shall be given continuously during not less than the last 100 feet traveled in a business or residential district and not less than the last 300 feet traveled in any other area
obligation.description: Measure continuous signal-active path length from original onset to original course change, conditional on district.

timing.source_clause: prior to changing the course of a vehicle. This rule shall be observed, regardless of the weather.
timing.description: Continuous signal duration is measured backward from observed course-change onset; no weather waiver.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: A signal of intention to turn right or left, or otherwise turn a vehicle from a direct course
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original visible signal and observed change from direct course require independent source review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: in a business or residential district
judgment_calls_needed.note: District classification must be established from original route context.
Other-area classification must be established from original route context.
Weather is source context and cannot waive either distance.
